_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); ratings, education and information signals

pit_profile.why: McGraw Hill Financial 'is a leading benchmarks & ratings, analytics, data and research provider serving the global capital, commodities and commercial markets' (Item 1); Item 1A: 'Changes in the volume of securities issued and traded in domestic and/or global capital markets and changes in interest rates and volatility in the financial markets could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition or results of operations.', and no risk factor calling a business cyclical; a fall in debt issuance or the markets it serves cuts revenue, and no disruption theme is live for the business on this date

classification.quality_note: McGraw Hill Financial 'is a leading benchmarks & ratings, analytics, data and research provider serving the global capital, commodities and commercial markets' (Item 1); Item 1A: 'Changes in the volume of securities issued and traded in domestic and/or global capital markets and changes in interest rates and volatility in the financial markets could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition or results of operations.', and no risk factor calling a business cyclical; a fall in debt issuance or the markets it serves cuts revenue, and no disruption theme is live for the business on this date. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price fair; Ratio B 1.56x; +3% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.10; conservative 2yr +26%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -39.1%/yr (worst year FY05-FY14, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +8.7%/yr (Q3 revenue + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +8.7%/yr (FY05-FY14 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +30.2%/yr (best 2-yr run FY05-FY14); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: MHFI (retrospective, 2016-01-15) ◐ WATCHLIST — Ratio B 1.56x (68.8% downside to Bear $26 / +44.2% upside to Bull $120) | Adj composite 2.29 vs market 2.39: gap -0.10 [FAIRLY VALUED] | +3% above the EPP floor $81 (18x FY15E $4.47) | Conservative 2-yr case: +25.7% total (+12.8%/yr) | At 18.6x FY15E the 15% hurdle price $110 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; Financial Services revenue +3.9% in Q3 2015, forward revenues +4.8% (no FY15 revenue guide in numbers, Q3 2015 growth); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
